_comment: EXAMPLE only -- copy the pattern into index-deny.json, do not rename this file in place (embed-vault.js and search-vault.js only read index-deny.json). Each entry is a vault-relative path PREFIX, matched case-insensitively against both '/' and '\\' separators via startsWith -- so 'projects/Acme-Deal' also denies 'projects/Acme-Deal/notes.md' and everything else under that folder. Add a prefix here the same session any client-confidential, under-NDA, or otherwise never-share material enters your vault; a stale/partially-filtered index is a leak, not a warning.
